name.zh: 大模型斩杀线与智能选型

description.zh: 大模型选型（L层）性价比斩杀线推演与预算配置工作台。支持散点图斩杀线交互、多任务画像预算降级核算、自定义模型补录（Local-First存储）与AI选型架构师深度诊断报告生成。
description.en: LLM selection and kill-zone cost-efficiency workbench with interactive scatter chart, task-budget profiling, local-first model registry, and AI architect diagnosis.

releaseNotes.zh: 终极重构v1.2.0：1. 彻底恢复原生黄金比例散点图，超宽屏96vw沉浸式排版；2. 校准左侧安全区与走量区模型（补齐MiniMax等真实数据）；3. AI发版新闻智能抽取一键上图；4. 侧边抽屉式大模型选型首席顾问多轮互动。
releaseNotes.en: v1.2.0 Ultimate: 1. Full 96vw widescreen golden scatter chart restored; 2. Calibrated Safe/Volume zones with MiniMax models; 3. AI news extraction to plot dots; 4. Drawer-style interactive AI advisor chat.
